#DaunteWright killing was not an accident.

Stop Killing Black people & let’s divest from policing. #JusticeForDaunteWright 
#BlackLivesMatter

#AdamToledo

#SayHisName 

13-years-old 

A child, a son, a student. 

We urgently need to #DefundThePolice and invest in community. Because #BlackLivesMatter but our broke institutions don’t reflect that. 

CONGRESS & @WhiteHouse NEED TO INTERVENE!
#BlackLivesMatter  and no Black and Brown person should be killed by the police.

Words from @POTUS are not enough. We need bold & transformative action now, not now or some day. That day has been the entire past year and years and has led to more murders. #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

I can’t... enough. A 15-year-old, a child kill by the police that she called hoping for protection after she felt unsafe and police end up killing her. What else need to happen for systemic change to happen? 

#makiyahbryant #DefundThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

3) This news, esp on the heels of many others, can be painful & triggering. But if something we have learned through #MeToo is the power of solidarity & care for survivors & each other. Listen, check in with friends, family, give them or yourself space & time. I’m here for you.💕

The decision by Pride to ban policing came from demands from trans & LGBTQ BIPOC+. If we care about racial justice & supported last summer #BLM rallies, then we should be more understanding of this decision. If one has questions or concerns, we should talk with queer POC first. https://t.co/yzKMO6F5au
